themes_detail.label: Illegal Dumping Surge
themes_detail.summary: Illegal dumping complaints spiked to 21 THIS WEEK, up 206% from the 6.9-per-week baseline over the prior 8 weeks, signaling a sudden and acute sanitation crisis in Sunnyside/Woodside that may reflect either enforcement gaps or a surge in illicit waste disposal activity.
evidence: 21 illegal dumping complaints THIS WEEK vs. 6.9 weekly average (206% spike, z-score: 4.5)
Sustained spike with high statistical confidence (z-score above 2.0 threshold)
No prior mention in recent local news or community board agendas, suggesting newly surfaced problem
reporting_angles: Where are the dumping hotspots in Sunnyside/Woodside and why are they vulnerable?
Has DSNY or Sanitation enforcement presence changed recently, or is this demand-driven (new construction sites, demolitions filed)?

themes_detail.label: Street Noise Spike
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints from streets and sidewalks jumped to 42 THIS WEEK, a 226% increase from the 12.9-per-week baseline, suggesting a concentrated disturbance event or ongoing street-level disruption affecting multiple blocks.
evidence: 42 street/sidewalk noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 12.9 weekly average (226% spike, z-score: 4.36)
High statistical confidence with sustained intensity this week
Noise - Residential complaints (834 over 90 days) remain chronic, but street-level noise is newly acute
reporting_angles: Is this spike tied to a specific event, construction project, or venue (outdoor dining, bars)?
Are there geographic clusters of complaints that point to a single source?

themes_detail.label: Outdoor Dining Complaints
themes_detail.summary: Outdoor dining complaints surged to 3 THIS WEEK, up 700% from the 0.4-per-week baseline, a statistically significant spike that may reflect new dining operations, regulatory compliance issues, or resident friction with expanded streetside seating.
evidence: 3 outdoor dining complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (700% spike, z-score: 5.42)
Timing aligns with potential reopenings or seasonal expansion of outdoor seating
No prior Community Board meeting records show outdoor dining as a recurring concern, suggesting this is emergent
reporting_angles: What new or expanded outdoor dining venues have opened or applied for permits in Sunnyside/Woodside?
Are complaints about noise, traffic, or blockages tied to specific restaurants or blocks?

themes_detail.label: Encampment Uptick
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints hit 34 last week, a 346% surge from the 7.6-per-week baseline, reflecting a sharp rise in street homelessness or visibility that may be outpacing city outreach capacity.
evidence: 34 encampment complaints last week vs. 7.6 weekly average (346% spike, z-score: 3.85)
Sustained spike over the past 7-14 days with high statistical significance
Community Board budget requests include park amenities and senior services, suggesting existing resource constraints
reporting_angles: Which corridors or parks in Sunnyside/Woodside have seen new or expanding encampments?
What outreach or service referrals are available to individuals experiencing homelessness, and are they meeting current demand?

themes_detail.label: Smoking/Vaping Complaints Rise
themes_detail.summary: Smoking and vaping complaints jumped to 11 two weeks ago, a 203% spike from the 3.6-per-week baseline, suggesting either a new venue or enforcement activity drawing resident complaints about secondhand smoke.
evidence: 11 smoking/vaping complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 3.6 weekly average (203% spike, z-score: 6.05)
Spike occurred 2 weeks ago; unclear if trend is sustained this week
No recent local news or CB mentions of smoking/vaping as a district-wide concern
reporting_angles: Are complaints concentrated around a specific bar, lounge, or public space?
Is this a complaint surge about enforcement laxity, or a new venue opening?
